scripts.setup: python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-data.mjs && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-data.mjs && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.test:rc:e2e: cd frontend && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config playwright.rc.config.js
